intro: Lesson 59: Shapes with the same area. To understand that different shapes can have the same area

questions.q: How many rectangles with whole sides have area 24 cm²?
Draw 3 different shapes (not all rectangles) with area 10 cm².
Find the areas of the 3 compound shapes on the sheet. Which two are equal?
questions.a: 14 cm², 14 cm², 15 cm²: the first two

questions.q: Can a shape with area 7 cm² be a rectangle with whole-number sides? Explain.
4 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm by 10 cm: A) same area B) different area
Big question: can different shapes have the same area?
questions.a: Yes: the area counts squares inside, not the shape's look
